title: Length of the small-bias generator list
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $\ell$ be a positive natural number. For any certified binary field implementation of degree $\ell$ (that is, one whose associated monic polynomial is irreducible), the executable small-bias generator list has length $2^{2\ell}$.
hypotheses_covered: The implementation's associated monic polynomial is irreducible
